name: wallet-derivation-check
description: Wallet derivation check: reads the JSON configuration of the accounts a crypto wallet app derives from one seed (coin, network, derivation path with account, change and index, address type and gap limit), never reads a seed or a key, fetches nothing and runs nothing, and lists the problems to fix before the wallet ships with file and line: paths that cannot be parsed, a purpose that does not match the address type (BIP-44, BIP-49, BIP-84, BIP-86), a coin type that is not the SLIP-44 number of the coin, testnet and mainnet coin types swapped, levels hardened or not hardened against BIP-44, change levels other than 0 and 1, ed25519 paths with unhardened levels (SLIP-10), two entries that derive the same key, gaps in the accounts that stop BIP-44 discovery and gap limits under 20. Text, markdown, JSON and SARIF output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
